text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and visualization using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets.

I recently worked on a Marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, an e-commerce client. I built a BigQuery + SQL model that joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in Looker Studio to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. One result: 18% of ad budget was reallocated, and customer acquisition cost was down 12% the next quarter.

For your PPC needs, I can help organize performance reporting, KPI tracking, and campaign analysis so you can review results clearly.

What reporting format do you want for the 3 campaign examples you requested: raw platform metrics, a dashboard, or a summarized performance report?
